note: Riverine and coastal flood risk to assets in low-lying areas. CRREM physical risk module, TCFD scenario analysis. Insurance repricing and asset devaluation.
Rising cooling demand and overheating risk in southern European and tropical portfolios. Affects EUI, tenant comfort, and GRESB performance scores.
Assets in WRI Aqueduct high-stress regions face water supply constraints. Relevant for cooling towers, landscaping, and tenant operations.

topic: Transition risk from local building performance ordinances
note: NYC Local Law 97 carbon caps, CA SB 253 climate disclosure, EU EPBD recast MEPS. Non-compliance triggers fines and limits asset liquidity.

topic: Stranded-asset risk from CRREM pathway overshoot
note: Assets exceeding CRREM 1.5 degree C carbon pathway face value write-downs. Stranding year analysis required by GRESB and growing number of institutional investors.
Envelope upgrades, heat-pump conversions, on-site PV. Reduces EUI, extends stranding year, improves EPC rating, and unlocks EU Taxonomy alignment for CapEx.
Corporate tenants increasingly require green lease clauses for Scope 3 reporting. Landlords offering data sharing and efficiency commitments attract premium tenants.
SFDR Article 8/9 funds must report taxonomy-aligned share of real estate holdings. Non-aligned assets face capital allocation headwinds from institutional investors.
A1-A3 embodied carbon dominates whole-life footprint of new builds. RICS Whole Life Carbon standard, GLA policy, Dutch MPG regulation drive reporting and limits.

topic: Energy poverty and social housing retrofit
note: Fuel-poor tenants in low-EPC housing face disproportionate energy cost burden. Social taxonomy dimension, SFDR PAI 14 (social), and reputational risk for housing REITs.
